title: Ultimate Client-Side
body:
## **Overview**
This client-side modpack tries to enhance the Vanilla experience of Minecraft through better performance, visuals and QoL features in every aspect of the game. It does not matter if you are a redstone engeneer, a farmer or a builder, there are must-have-features for everyone!

The Pack is completly client-side, so it is build for singlplayer as well as multiplayer. 

Before joining a server with this modpack, you should check out the server-rules. This is because the pack contains mods wich might give you an unfair advantage or are even considered cheating.

## **Modpack Content**

**Mods:**
- [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/project/EsAfCjCV)
- [Boat Item View](https://modrinth.com/project/vqnOCHgM)
- [BoatView360](https//modrinth.com/project/vqnOCHgM)

**Dependencies**
- [Architectury](https://modrinth.com/project/lhGA9TYQ)
- [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/project/9s6osm5g) - Required by many mods to use their in-game config menus.
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/project/P7dR8mSH) - Required by all Fabric mods.
- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/project/Ha28R6CL)
- [Iris](https//modrinth.com/project/YL57xq9U) - Required by all Shaderpacks.
- [JamLib](https//modrinth.com/project/IYY9Siz8)
- [MaLiLib](https://modrinth.com/project/GcWjdA9I)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/project/mOgUt4GM) - Allows in-game configuration of Fabric mods.
- [Placeholder API](https://modrinth.com/project/eXts2L7r)
- [YetAnotherConfigLib](https://modrinth.com/project/1eAoo2KR)


**Shaderpacks**
- [Complementary Shaders - Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/project/HVnmMxH1) (not enabled by default) - Recommended shader pack
